title: Pentaryn Reactions
description: A non-blocking reminder card: when a monster hits or damages a player character, the character's owner is whispered a card listing the reaction-timed spells and features that fit (Shield, Absorb Elements); one click uses the activity. Nothing waits on it and nothing is applied by it.

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), enable 'Pentaryn Reactions', then reload.
